editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: NAGA is a legitimate social trading broker scoring 6.6/10 from NAFT in 2026. Owned by NAGA Group AG — listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (XETRA: N4G) — and regulated by CySEC (licence 204/13) with BaFin cross-border notification. The platform offers 3,000+ instruments across forex, real stocks, stock CFDs, crypto, indices, ETFs, and commodities — with integrated social trading, auto-copy functionality, and a community leaderboard as the central proposition. MT4 and MT5 are available for traditional charting. The $50 minimum deposit keeps the barrier low. But the declining share price of the parent company raises legitimate corporate survival questions, and CySEC-only regulation means no FCA or ASIC safety net. If you want social/copy trading with stock-exchange transparency — NAGA delivers something unique. If you need multi-regulator protection or institutional-grade pricing — look at eToro or Pepperstone.
